0.original: Wuk Lamat wishes to look in on her soldiers.

48.original: I wish there was something I could do to help...

49.original: I understand Zoraal Ja spared no souls for reviving himself in battle. His pride wouldn't permit him to do otherwise, I expect...

50.original: Well, it was good to catch Koana up. Now we'll talk to the sol─ ...Hm?

53.original: ...Is that so? In that case, let's meet at Sunperch. See you soon!

54.original: Y'shtola is heading back. I dare to hope she's found a way to pursue Sphene.

55.original: If you all wanted to go on ahead to Sunperch, I'll pay our soldiers a quick call.

57.original: You're all here. Then that means...

58.original: Aye. We believe we've found a way to travel to the reflection to where Sphene has retreated.

59.original: I was busy providing aid in Solution Nine, so I haven't heard the details myself.

60.original: Could you start from the beginning, Y'shtola?

61.original: Per Sphene's own words, the gate atop Everkeep was opened and closed by the power of interdimensional fusion.

62.original: And it was the artifact known as the key that allowed her to control it.

63.original: According to Ketenramm, the key was brought with me to the Source twenty years ago.

64.original: It was then kept here in the palace until its theft by Zoraal Ja, who used it in Yyasulani to fuse a portion of our world with this reflection.

65.original: Following Zoraal Ja's demise, Sphene claimed the key and disappeared through the gate.

66.original: But where exactly did that gate lead? In seeking the answer, we took another look at Origenics─and made a startling discovery.

67.original: As you all know, there should have been one more level at the summit of Everkeep.

68.original: The twelfth level─the King of Resolve's royal abode.

69.original: Right. But when you actually went there, you saw that it didn't exist.

70.original: Curious, we analyzed Origenics's logs to see where the memories of the departed were being sent. And where should it be but <hex:021A020203>through<hex:021A020103> the gate, to the missing twelfth level.

71.original: That level alone must have lain outside the fused region, and so was left behind.

74.original: The reflection to which Sphene has fled is her own.

75.original: Alphinaud, if you'd be so kind!

77.original: 'Tis Sphene's home world, and she has returned there, to join the memories of her departed citizens.

78.original: It means that beyond the gate lies not just any reflection, but the one from which Alexandria originally hailed.

79.original: 'Tis Sphene's home world, and she has returned there, to join the memories of her departed citizens.

80.original: But as the key lies with her on the other side, we haven't the means to reopen the gate.

81.original: Forgive me, but I thought we already knew she had gone home─or at least it seemed obvious to me. What I want to know is, how do we pursue Sphene if the gate here is closed?

82.original: We use another gate. And it just so happens we know where one is.

84.original: Aye. All evidence suggests that the gate there leads to the world whence the Alexandrians and I came.

85.original: But assuming that's true, how can we open it?

86.original: That is what we shall find out, using the code in this earring.

87.original: As you'll recall, Krile's earring is in fact a data storage device.

88.original: An analysis of it yielded a code─something used to control a contraption, and a very large one at that.

89.original: Given the circumstances of Krile's arrival in the Source, we believe that said contraption is the gate to the golden city.

90.original: This is admittedly an educated guess, but we are quite hopeful that it will work.

91.original: To make such progress in so short a time... You really are amazing!

92.original: We couldn't have done it alone. The credit must go to the members of Oblivion for acquiring the information we needed, Shale especially.

93.original: Right then, it seems the plan is set! To the Skydeep Cenote!

95.original: I've told the officers of the Landsguard about my intention. They fully support our endeavor.

96.original: Begging your pardon, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but might I have a moment ere setting forth?

97.original: Oh, you're already going to give <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> the thing?

98.original: Yes. I had thought to save it for later, but in light of these developments, I feel now is the time.

99.original: As Lamaty'i says, I have something for you. Please come with me to Bayside Bevy.

100.original: Are these all shops? It's so different from Solution Nine!

101.original: Hehe, I hope you like it!

102.original: Tuliyollal is safe in no small part due to your valor. As a token of our appreciation, I have commissioned special equipment for you.

103.original: While it is inadequate as an expression of gratitude, I pray it will serve you well in your coming mission.

104.original: It apparently incorporates foreign technology. Leave it to Koana to request such a thing, eh?

105.original: Mewazunte yonder has the equipment in his keeping. Just say the word, and he will bring it out.

106.original: You may now obtain job-specific gear from Mewazunte.

107.original: The weapons and gear obtained can be equipped at level 99. However, all item stats will be subject to item level sync.

108.original: Upon reaching level 100 with the corresponding job, these items will no longer be synced.

109.original: Furthermore, the gear can be dyed upon completion of the role quests associated with said job.
